dedupe_keys.name: on site demonstrations of c its architecture and autonomous vehicle operation in the city of trikala greece

description: The source documents an on-site Trikala pilot integrating autonomous electric minivans with a defined route and C-ITS infrastructure. It describes fleet monitoring, speed advice, traffic-responsive green-wave control, vulnerable-road-user warning messages and a multimodal trip-planning application. The paper establishes the pilot architecture and deployment while leaving effectiveness and societal evaluation to future work. No outcome or public software access is invented. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: On-Site Demonstrations of C-ITS Architecture and Autonomous Vehicle Operation in the City of Trikala, Greece
notes: Native publication date is not a verified observation interval. Project membership alone does not establish resource inclusion. Listed unverified routes timed out in zero-body landing checks; exact native metadata was retrieved successfully. Underlying files remain unchecked.
